response: Pneumologists' skepticism towards chemotherapy in advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma is not entirely justified. In normal clinical practice, chemotherapy has been shown to significantly prolong survival in patients with a performance status of less than 2, with more time being gained if there is no associated weight loss. This suggests that chemotherapy can be an effective treatment option for patients with advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma, and pneumologists should consider it as a viable treatment approach.
